locale_failed: Could not save the language setting.
raw_flags: Raw flag bits; undefined flags may vary.
no_memory: No memory captured. Load a program or inspect a mapped address.
source_changed: The machine uses an earlier build. Rebuild and load to apply your edits.
error_assembly: Assembly failed. Check the source and architecture.
error_input: Check addresses, memory ranges, register values and execution limits.
error_completion: Set a stop address or a uniquely defined symbol.
error_engine: Engine unavailable. Restart it to continue.
error_deadline: The engine timed out and was stopped. Restart it to continue.
error_memory: The engine exceeded its memory limit and was stopped. Restart it to continue.
error_state: The machine state changed. Check its status before continuing.
error_storage: Draft recovery is unavailable. Copy your source before closing this window.
unknown_outcome: The last operation may have completed. Check the machine state before trying again.
configuration_hint: Rebuild after changing the link address. Other settings apply on load; reset restores the initial machine state.
load_hint: Load this build into a new machine.
run_hint: Run until the stop position, a breakpoint, or the instruction limit.
stop_hint: Stop execution. Reset before running again.
reset_hint: Restore the loaded program, initial registers and memory.
machine_empty_hint: Assemble source or import machine code, then load it to inspect the machine.
workflow_run: Step through instructions or run to the stop position.
source_unlinked: This session is not linked to the current source. To run this source, assemble and load it.
editor_failed: The editor could not load. Reopen this window to try again.
instructions_empty: Assemble source or import machine code to view instructions.
instructions_hint: Disassemble from a known instruction boundary. Select an instruction for static analysis.
error_decode: Cannot decode this byte range. Check the architecture, address and starting offset.
error_file_encoding: The file is not valid UTF-8 text.
error_file_size: Assembly files cannot exceed 256 KiB. Binary and ELF files must be between 1 byte and 1 MiB.
error_file_read: Could not read the selected file.
error_file_write: Could not export the file. Choose a writable location.
error_file_conflict: The source changed during import. Import again to replace it.
analysis_hint: Static analysis may be incomplete. Recognizing an instruction does not mean the engine can execute it.
analysis_partial_registers: Some saved or restored registers are not listed.
initial_setup_hint: Each architecture keeps its own register and memory settings until this window closes.
extra_memory_hint: Memory is zero-filled. Addresses and sizes must be page-aligned; regions must not overlap each other or image pages. For a stack, also set RSP or SP.
initial_registers_hint: Unspecified general-purpose registers start at zero. Enter unsigned 64-bit values in decimal or 0x hexadecimal.
raw_empty: Import machine code from Files, then set its load, entry and stop addresses.
raw_hint: Code is mapped read/execute, without relocation or an implicit stack. Loading replaces the current machine.
raw_changed: The loaded code no longer matches these inputs. Load again to apply your changes.
breakpoints_hint: Pause before executing the instruction at each address. Reset keeps breakpoints.
live_decode_hint: Disassembly uses captured memory. To see changes, refresh memory and disassemble again.
patch_hint: Write up to 4 KiB of data or code. Reset restores the loaded state.
register_edit_hint: Use unsigned decimal or 0x-prefixed hexadecimal. Reset restores initial values.
register_zero_extend_hint: Writing a 32-bit value clears the upper 32 bits.
register_partial_hint: Only the selected byte or word changes; all other bits are preserved.
register_pc_hint: Sets the next instruction address and rearms breakpoints without executing. AArch64 requires 4-byte alignment.
register_flag_hint: Enter 0 to clear or 1 to set this flag. Other bits stay unchanged. Reset restores initial flags.
vector_lanes_hint: Expand a register to inspect its bits and lanes. Lane 0 holds the least-significant bits.
vector_invalid: Enter a valid {format} value within its range.
vector_raw_hint: Up to {digits} hexadecimal digits; an optional 0x prefix is accepted.
vector_integer_hint: Decimal integer within the selected signed or unsigned range.
vector_float_hint: Decimal or scientific notation; also accepts -0, Infinity and NaN. Use raw hex for exact NaN bits.
vector_edit_hint: Edits preserve all bits outside the selected lane or alias. Reset restores the initial state.
rounding_hint: Updates MXCSR.RC or FPCR.RMode. Instructions with explicit rounding are unaffected.
editor_placeholder: Write assembly, open a file, or load an example.
vector_predicate_hint: One predicate bit per byte. Wider elements use the first bit of each group; FFR records first-fault status.
source_map_truncated: Source location limit reached. Some lines are omitted.
step_over_hint: Execute one instruction. For a call, stop at its return address once the stack pointer is restored.
trace_hint: Up to 512 instruction starts, oldest first. A recorded instruction may still fault.
